<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## BIONEURAL: The Synapse Run

A complete, browser-playable neon platform game. Recover all three memory shards in the Synapse Foundry and reach the uplink before losing your signal.

### Play

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve this folder with any static web server. Use **A/D** or **←/→** to move, **Space** or **↑** to jump, and **Q** to switch between Material and Echo planes. On touch screens, use the on-screen controls. Press **R** to reboot the run.

The Material and Echo planes have different suspended bridges. The main floor is shared; switch planes in midair to route across gaps and collect every shard. Checkpoints preserve your progress through the level.

content.text:
Built **BIONEURAL: The Synapse Run** as a complete, self-contained browser game in `index.html`.

The level, Synapse Foundry, adds a **phase-shift mechanic**: switch between Material and Echo planes to use their distinct bridges, recover all three memory shards, and reach the uplink. It includes hazards, checkpoints, a limited signal-sync retry challenge, keyboard and touch controls, and a restart option.

I also added play instructions to `README.md`. **Assumption:** this blank project was intended to host a standalone web game. JavaScript syntax checks passed; I couldn’t verify the game in a browser because Chromium isn’t installed in the environment.
